name: UniFi
tagline: Reports on your Ubiquiti network and cameras each morning
description: For a house wired with Ubiquiti kit and an owner who prefers a summary to opening the console. Point it at your own UniFi connection and Notion workspace and it files a short account of how the network held up overnight, plus whatever the cameras picked up. It only reads state  -  settings stay as you left them.
author: Joe
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
